name: clarify
description: Full-stack CRM for GTM teams. Search and update records, send emails, launch campaigns, and find new leads in Clarify, plus skills for the plays your team runs every day.

interface.longDescription:
Clarify is a full-stack CRM. Records, enrichment, prospecting, meetings, email, and campaigns live in one place, so ChatGPT can do the work, not just look it up.

Ask ChatGPT to prep you for your next call, flag deals at risk this quarter, or find twenty new leads that fit your ICP. Then have it update the records, build the list, and launch the campaign without bouncing between tools. Most CRM apps stop at a draft. Clarify finishes the job.

Clarify also includes Clarify Agents, which you can build and configure right from ChatGPT to automate your GTM motion, plus built-in skills for the plays your team runs every day.
capabilities: Prep and follow up on meetings
defaultPrompt: Give me my daily brief in Clarify.
Prep me for my next meeting.
Which deals are at risk this quarter?

positive.prompt: Give me my daily brief in Clarify.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize today's meetings, deals that changed since yesterday, and replies needing attention, using only test workspace data.

positive.prompt: Prep me for my next meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the next calendar event, list attendees with their companies and open deals, and summarize the last recorded conversation.

positive.prompt: Which open deals are at risk this quarter?
positive.expected_behavior: List open deals closing this quarter with stale activity or slipped close dates, with amounts and stages from the workspace.

positive.prompt: Move the Acme deal to Negotiation and add a note that pricing was sent.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the Acme deal, update its stage to Negotiation, add the comment, and confirm the change.

positive.prompt: Find 10 VP Sales contacts at Series B SaaS companies in Seattle.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching candidates from Lead Finder, flag any already in the CRM, and ask before importing anything.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Seattle for next Tuesday.
Charge Acme's credit card for their renewal.
Show me deals from a competitor's Clarify workspace.

review.commerce_description: Clarify does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Adds 9 bundled skills (setup, daily brief, meeting prep, meeting follow-up, pipeline review, research, prospect, outreach, and API) to the existing Clarify MCP app.
